fullDescription:
Esthary is a stylish elegant serif typeface designed to bring a sophisticated and graceful character to your creative projects. Featuring high-contrast letterforms, refined proportions, distinctive details, and expressive alternate characters, Esthary creates an editorial and luxurious visual impression.

Perfect for fashion magazines, luxury branding, beauty campaigns, editorial layouts, wedding invitations, cosmetics, perfume packaging, boutique identities, logos, headlines, posters, and social media designs. Its elegant personality works beautifully for both minimalist compositions and sophisticated statement typography.

Esthary includes a carefully crafted character set with uppercase and lowercase letters, numerals, punctuation, multilingual support, and stylistic alternates/ligatures, making it suitable for branding, print, and digital design projects.
